messages:
Priya: Need a 14d export of auth+session logs for partner security review (partner asks for session_id, outcome, ts). Is it ok to send hashed user identifiers and obfuscated IPs?
Sam: short: yes but must go through export-proxy. scrub + per-export salt + envelope key. no cleartext PII out.
Jon: RBAC: create a scoped role export/partner-cti with s3:PutObject only to partner prefix, kms:Encrypt for the proxy wrapper. no list/get.
Priya: any retention mismatch? partner wants 14d but our default is 180d. we'll only slice 14d and document retention in contract.
LegalBot: contract note: require prohibition on re-sharing, attest deletion clause, and liability cap. add this to SOW.
Sam: implementation note: lambda scrub rules will drop headers and redact ips with /\d+$/ mask. also rotate ephemeral salt per export.
Jon: policy snippet (very small):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::partner-bucket/cti/*","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456:role/export-proxy-partner-cti"}}]}
```
Priya: ok. also need incident-preserve toggle: if triage is tied to an active incident we freeze deletion for 90d.
Sam: agree. we'll add ticket flag and block the export delete lambda on that tag.
sec-bot: Auto-scan: scrub rules passed. No raw-ip or email fields detected. (reacts :white_check_mark:)
Priya: Action items: Jon - create IAM role + policy, Sam - PR for scrub lambda + KMS envelope flow, Legal - insert contract clauses. I'll open the export request ticket now. Thanks.
